method.method_draft: From the image, take the waveform period as T = 0.1 s. Compute the fundamental angular frequency: ω0 = 2π/T = 20π rad/s. The Fourier components are at 0, 20π, 40π, 60π, ... rad/s. The text gives the ideal low-pass cutoff ωc = 50π rad/s, so only DC, the first harmonic, and the second harmonic pass. With gain 1 and zero phase, their forms and coefficients are unchanged, giving C0 + C1 sin(20πt) + C2 sin(40πt).
